allOf.description: Inherits shared step-base properties ($schema, id, owner, created_at, canonical_refs_used).

nfrs.description: Array of non-functional requirements specifying measurable quality attributes for the system.

items.description: A single non-functional requirement with category, metric target, measurement method, and traceability.

nfr_id.description: Unique identifier for this NFR in the format 'nfr-<category>-<name>' (e.g., 'nfr-latency-api-response').

category.description: Quality attribute category: latency, throughput, availability, durability, cost, security, privacy, maintainability, usability, portability, or energy.

metric.description: Name of the metric being measured (e.g., 'p99 response time', 'uptime percentage').

target.description: Target value for this NFR metric, either numeric or a string containing a number.

oneOf.description: String target value containing at least one digit (e.g., '<200ms', '>99.9%').

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the metric (e.g., 'ms', 'percent', 'req/s').

measurement_method.description: How this NFR will be measured or verified (e.g., 'synthetic monitoring', 'load test').

stage.description: Delivery stage at which this NFR must be met (e.g., 'mvp', 'ga').

owner.description: Team or domain responsible for meeting this NFR.

trace.description: Traceability links back to upstream requirements, components, or APIs.

items.description: A traceability reference for this non-functional requirement.

metric_ref.description: Canonical reference to the metric definition in the canonical registry.

unit_ref.description: Canonical reference to the unit of measurement in the canonical registry.

stage_ref.description: Canonical reference to the delivery stage in the canonical registry.

environment_ref.description: Canonical reference to the environment where this NFR is measured.
